## Cardiovascular Mortality by Race/Ethnicity

<iframe
  src="graphs/race_mortality.html"
  width="120%"
  height="550px"
  style="border: none; margin-left: -10%;"
  frameborder="0">
</iframe>

<div class="graph-caption">
  <span class="caption-label">♡ Health Equity Spotlight</span>

  <span class="caption-highlight">Black populations</span>
  experience the highest cardiovascular mortality rate in this
  comparison, followed by Native Hawaiian and Other Pacific
  Islander populations. These differences emphasize the importance
  of health equity initiatives, culturally responsive care, and
  addressing structural barriers to cardiovascular health.
</div>

## Cardiovascular Mortality by Sex

<iframe
  src="graphs/sex_mortality.html"
  width="120%"

  style="border: none; margin-left: -10%;"

<div class="graph-caption">

  Male populations experience substantially higher cardiovascular

  cardiovascular care.
